## P02 — Compute YoY Variances and Key Margins (Test Inc., YTD 2026 vs Prior Year, USD)

### YoY Variance & Margin Table

| Line Item | Actual (USD) | Prior Year (USD) | YoY Change ($) | YoY Change (%) | Actual Margin (% Rev) | Prior Year Margin (% Rev) | Margin Delta (bps / pp) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Revenue** | $1,150,000 | $1,000,000 | +$150,000 | +15.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% | — |
| **COGS** | $690,000 | $620,000 | +$70,000 | +11.3% | 60.0% | 62.0% | -200 bps |
| **Gross Profit** | $460,000 | $380,000 | +$80,000 | +21.1% | 40.0% | 38.0% | +200 bps |
| **Operating Expenses** | $300,000 | $275,000 | +$25,000 | +9.1% | 26.1% | 27.5% | -136 bps (-1.4 pp) |
| **EBITDA** | $160,000 | $105,000 | +$55,000 | +52.4% | 13.9% | 10.5% | +339 bps (+3.4 pp) |

---

### Detailed Calculations & Margin Walk

1. **YoY Dollar and Percentage Variances:**
   - **Revenue:** $\$1,150,000 - \$1,000,000 = +\$150,000$ ($+15.0\%$)
   - **COGS:** $\$690,000 - \$620,000 = +\$70,000$ ($+11.3\%$)
   - **Gross Profit:** $\$460,000 - \$380,000 = +\$80,000$ ($+21.1\%$)
   - **Operating Expenses:** $\$300,000 - \$275,000 = +\$25,000$ ($+9.1\%$)
   - **EBITDA:** $\$160,000 - \$105,000 = +\$55,000$ ($+52.4\%$)

2. **Profitability Margins (% of Revenue):**
   - **Gross Margin:**
     - Actual: $\frac{\$460,000}{\$1,150,000} = 40.0\%$
     - Prior Year: $\frac{\$380,000}{\$1,000,000} = 38.0\%$
     - Delta: $+2.0\text{ pp}$ ($+200\text{ bps}$)
   - **Operating Expenses % of Revenue:**
     - Actual: $\frac{\$300,000}{\$1,150,000} = 26.087\% \approx 26.1\%$
     - Prior Year: $\frac{\$275,000}{\$1,000,000} = 27.500\% = 27.5\%$
     - Delta: $-1.36\text{ to } -1.41\text{ pp}$ ($-136\text{ bps}$)
   - **EBITDA Margin:**
     - Actual: $\frac{\$160,000}{\$1,150,000} = 13.913\% \approx 13.9\%$
     - Prior Year: $\frac{\$105,000}{\$1,000,000} = 10.500\% = 10.5\%$
     - Delta: $+3.39\text{ to } +3.41\text{ pp}$ ($+339\text{ bps}$)

3. **Reconciliation & Rounding Check:**
   - All line items tie directly to P01 verified inputs.
   - Rounding variances are $<0.1\%$.

---

### Evidence
- Verified dependency output from **P01 (Ingest P&L data and validate totals)**.
- Governed context: Company: Test Inc., Analysis period: YTD 2026, Currency: USD.

### Assumptions
- Margin calculations use total Revenue as the denominator.
- Basis points (bps) and percentage changes are rounded according to SOP precision rules ($\le 0.1\%$ rounding tolerance).

### Acceptance Result
- **PASS**:
  - YoY deltas computed for all lines (Revenue $+150,000 / +15.0\%$; COGS $+70,000 / +11.3\%$; Gross Profit $+80,000 / +21.1\%$; OpEx $+25,000 / +9.1\%$; EBITDA $+55,000 / +52.4\%$).
  - Margins computed: Gross Margin $40.0\%$ vs $38.0\%$ ($+200\text{ bps}$); OpEx % Rev $26.1\%$ vs $27.5\%$ ($-136\text{ bps}$); EBITDA Margin $13.9\%$ vs $10.5\%$ ($+339\text{ bps}$).
  - All calculations tie back to ingested totals with no rounding differences exceeding $0.1\%$.

### Unresolved Gaps
- None.

primitives.capability: Materiality screening, driver attribution, threshold-based highlighting.
acceptance: Materiality thresholds calculated: 1.0% of revenue = 11,500; 5.0% of EBITDA = 8,000; binding threshold = 8,000.
All YoY changes are assessed vs threshold and labeled material/non-material; all provided line deltas are material (>= 25,000).

## P03 — Apply Materiality Thresholds and Flag Material Drivers (Test Inc., YTD 2026, USD)

---

### 1. Materiality Threshold Determination

Materiality is calculated based on current period (YTD 2026 Actual) financials in accordance with the governing policy:
- **Revenue Materiality Threshold (1.0% of Revenue):**  
  $$1.0\% \times \$1,150,000 = \$11,500$$
- **EBITDA Materiality Threshold (5.0% of EBITDA):**  
  $$5.0\% \times \$160,000 = \$8,000$$
- **Binding Materiality Threshold:**  
  $$\mathbf{\$8,000}\quad (\text{lower/most conservative threshold applied})$$

---

### 2. Line-Item Materiality Assessment

Each YoY variance is evaluated against the binding materiality threshold of **$8,000**:

| Line Item | Actual (USD) | Prior Year (USD) | Absolute YoY Change ($) | Threshold ($) | Materiality Status | Primary Driver Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Revenue** | $1,150,000 | $1,000,000 | $150,000 | $8,000 | **Material** ($\ge \$8,000$) | Top-line expansion |
| **COGS** | $690,000 | $620,000 | $70,000 | $8,000 | **Material** ($\ge \$8,000$) | Direct cost increase |
| **Gross Profit** | $460,000 | $380,000 | $80,000 | $8,000 | **Material** ($\ge \$8,000$) | Profitability expansion |
| **Operating Expenses** | $300,000 | $275,000 | $25,000 | $8,000 | **Material** ($\ge \$8,000$) | Overhead cost growth |
| **EBITDA** | $160,000 | $105,000 | $55,000 | $8,000 | **Material** ($\ge \$8,000$) | Bottom-line earnings growth |

*Note: All provided line deltas exceed the binding threshold ($\text{minimum delta} = \$25,000 \ge \$8,000$) and are classified as material.*

---

### 3. EBITDA Bridge & Reconciliation

Reconciliation of Prior Year EBITDA ($105,000) to Current Period EBITDA ($160,000):

| Bridge Step | Amount (USD) | Impact Direction | Cumulative EBITDA (USD) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Prior Year EBITDA** | — | Base | **$105,000** |
| (+) Revenue Impact | +$150,000 | Favorable | $255,000 |
| (–) COGS Increase | -$70,000 | Unfavorable | $185,000 |
| **(=) Gross Profit Improvement** | **+$80,000** | **Favorable** | **$185,000** |
| (–) Operating Expense Increase | **-$25,000** | **Unfavorable** | **$160,000** |
| **Actual YTD 2026 EBITDA** | — | **Total** | **$160,000** |
| **Total Net EBITDA Change** | **+$55,000** | **Favorable** | — |

**Reconciliation Check:**  
$$\text{PY EBITDA } (\$105,000) + \text{GP Delta } (+\$80,000) - \text{OpEx Delta } (\-\$25,000) = \text{Actual EBITDA } (\$160,000)$$  
$$\text{Reconciliation Variance} = \$0\text{ USD}$$

---

### 4. Prioritized List of Top Drivers of EBITDA Change

Ranked by absolute magnitude of impact on EBITDA:

1. **Gross Profit Expansion (+$80,000 | Favorable):**
   - **Magnitude:** $\$80,000$
   - **Mechanism:** Driven by top-line revenue growth ($+\$150,000$ / $+15.0\%$) outpacing COGS growth ($+\$70,000$ / $+11.3\%$), expanding Gross Margin from $38.0\%$ to $40.0\%$ ($+200\text{ bps}$).
2. **Operating Expenses Increase (-$25,000 | Unfavorable):**
   - **Magnitude:** $\$25,000$
   - **Mechanism:** OpEx increased from $\$275,000$ to $\$300,000$ ($+9.1\%$), partially offsetting gross profit gains, although OpEx as a percentage of revenue improved from $27.5\%$ to $26.1\%$ ($-136\text{ bps}$ operating leverage).

---

### Governed Execution Metadata

- **Evidence:**
  - Governed context: Test Inc., YTD 2026, Currency: USD.
  - Dependency verified output: P02 YoY Variance and Margin Calculations.
  - Policy: SOP-2026-Q3-Rev5 (Materiality: 1.0% Revenue / 5.0% EBITDA).

- **Assumptions:**
  - Binding threshold is established at the lower of 1.0% Revenue ($11,500) and 5.0% EBITDA ($8,000), yielding $8,000.
  - Standard EBITDA sign convention: Favorable changes are positive (+), unfavorable cost increases are negative (-).

- **Acceptance Result:**
  - **PASS**:
    - Materiality thresholds calculated: 1.0% of revenue = $11,500; 5.0% of EBITDA = $8,000; binding threshold = $8,000.
    - All YoY changes assessed vs threshold and labeled material; all line deltas are material ($\ge \$25,000$).
    - EBITDA bridge drivers quantified and reconciled to $+55,000$ ($+80,000$ GP improvement offset by $-\$25,000$ OpEx increase).
    - Prioritized list of top drivers by magnitude with clear sign convention provided.

- **Unresolved Gaps:**
  - None.
